title: The Bill Murray Stories: Life Lessons Learned from a Mythical Man
short_description: 2018 documentary film directed by Tommy Avallone

text.lead: The Bill Murray Stories: Life Lessons Learned from a Mythical Man is a 2018 American documentary film written, edited and directed by Tommy Avallone.
text.plot: The film explores and investigates several urban legends surrounding American actor and comedian Bill Murray.
text.cast:
- Tommy Avallone
- John Barnhardt
- Christopher Beaumont
text.reception:
The review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes reported a 95% approval rating based on 21 reviews.
Peter Howell of the Toronto Star gave the film 3 out of 4 stars, stating: " The Bill Murray Stories: Life Lessons Learned From a Mythical Man addresses the very real title star’s amusingly bizarre habit of casually barging into regular lives." Richard Roeper, writing for the Chicago Sun-Times, gave The Bill Murray Stories 3.5 out of 4 stars. John DeFore from The Hollywood Reporter called it "an enjoyable but hardly essential pop-culture exploration".
